title: Let run records resolve upstream PRs
problem: 167 of 175 records carry merged: null because their PR lives in the upstream research repository, so success rates are unverifiable.
change: Add a `repo` field (default this repository) to records, written by `record --repo`, so a review can look the PR up.
result: Partly helped: records with merged known 28 of 369 (7.6%) vs baseline 8 of 184 (4.3%). The `repo` field exists (record --repo) but only 6 records set it, and 276 research records remain merged: null because they are bulk-mirrored. The field is not the limit; backfilling the mirrored records is.
